jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time. Your Role As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it. This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work. People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building. A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it. *This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required. What you will own in your first year The people agenda for your client groups. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies. We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries. WHY JOIN US? You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity.
